name: coll_tp8_colr_a-r2-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 compute-die collective (qfd_io_collective) wrapper column leaf, registered-return redesign (qwen-coll-io 10-14, el1014-qwen-coll-io.log). 14 x 32x128 macros (wt3a plan + LQ/TQ to 128 words); 237.6 x 237.6 (r1 gate at 259.2 x 291.6: util 24 %, GPL-0305 divergence), cap M5, recipe 1 + macro-edge M5 guard (the wt3a closure recipe). Composition benches: 8-rank TP8 golden ((P0+P1)+P2)+P3 with Pp = die0+die1, exact unit 9 cases + production 3 cases; mutants OT_TP8_MUT_OWNER / OT_TP8_MUT_GATHER / OT_TP8R_MUT_SEAM (the EQ write takes the live, un-aligned word) all fail.

structural_change: NEW master (WT 2) after 29 failed qfd_io_collective routes: the WT 1 column leaf took every word in on W and out on E, so the pairing (heads -> lo/hi -> hl/hh/gh), EQ (heads/gh/fold-slice sum -> eq_wd), result (engine e_od -> lq_wd/tq_wd) and merger (heads -> m_d -> od) loops left the leaf and returned across 500-900 um into un-registered SRAM write pins. ot_coll_tp8_col_tile_r computes every pairing/gather/merger word INSIDE the leaf from its own heads (static die/meta straps), registers every externally fed write word (fold-slice sum, engine results) at its pin and writes it one edge later, and lands c_hold (512 loads from the port) in a pin flop with a pre-hold copy. Pins face their consumers: E link words, W engine, N pre-fold slices, S control + head meta. +1 edge on the reduce path and +1 on the result path (production AR256 496 vs 494 at LAT 40). Result queues sized to the board crossing: LQ 128 / TQ 128 (14 macros; the closed WT 1 leaf had 9) so that with the DEPTH 64 engine (ot_coll_col_tile_d64) the TP8 AR256 is ~953 cycles at LAT 339 instead of 1,683.
